top_violation_types.title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One food allergy plan was not signed by the parent.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric CPR.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that a child was left unattended, the caregiver was not at a physical proximity that allowed visual and/or auditory awareness of the child in care.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS Investigation.

top_violation_types.title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A report was not made to Child Care Regulation for an incident that potentially posed a risk to children.
